item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find 2024 evidence of Sharif creating a new, durable civilian oversight body, police complaint authority, prison inspectorate, or independent abuse-investigation mechanism specifically under his government. The affirmative evidence is narrow and mostly reactive; the broader 2024 record still points to weak accountability.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan will set up inquiry commission to investigate army’s meddling in judiciary, law minister says","publisher":"Reuters via Al Jazeera","date":"2024-03-28","url":"https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/28/pakistan-to-investigate-armys-meddling-in-judiciary-law-minister-says","summary":"After six High Court judges alleged ISI intimidation in politically sensitive cases, the Sharif government said it would form an inquiry commission.
